senses.gloss:
स्त्यै {c1c} U. (स्त्यायति-ते)
1 To be
collected into a heap or mass.
--2 To
spread about, be diffused;
शिशिरकदुकषायः स्त्यायते सल्लकीनां Māl. 9. 6,
2. 21; Mv. 5. 41.
--3 Sound, echo.

स्त्यान a. [स्त्यै-क्त]
1 Collected
into a mass; Māl. 5. 11, Ve. 1. 21.
--2
Thick, bulky, gross.
--3 Soft, bland,
smooth, unctuous.
--4 Sounding.
--नं
1 Thickness, grossness, increase
in magnitude or bulk; दधति
कुहरभाजामत्र भल्लूकयूनामनुरसितगुरूणि स्त्यानमंबू
कृतानि Māl. 9. 6; U. 2. 21,
[]
Mv. 5. 41.
--2 Unctuousness.
--3 Nectar.
--4 Sloth, idleness.
--5 Echo, sound.

स्त्यायनं Collecting into a mass,
crowding together, aggregation.
